theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is one of only two top-8 themes with a clean 'trend' hurst tag (not mixed or mean-revert), it is eligible under the absolute-trend gate, and it is not crowded. In a narrowing-rotation tape where the absolute-trend gate is the only validated risk-control leg, a trend-eligible, uncrowded theme offers better drawdown characteristics than the fading leader. This is a relative-trend lean, not a return forecast.
evidence: eligible = true (passes the validated absolute-trend gate)
theses.dissent: Energy is highly macro-sensitive (oil supply/demand, geopolitics) and macro_narrative shows 100% unscheduled surprise share — an abrupt headline shock can gap the trend quickly, and the trend-tag alone carries no return edge.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is rank 2 and has perfect breadth (1.0) with a trend tag, but crowding_z is 1.8 and crowded=true — the most crowded theme in the top ranks. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution and never a fade, but at the portfolio level it argues against adding here versus the uncrowded trend-eligible energy complex. Momentum rank itself carries no alpha, so a crowded #2 offers unattractive risk/reward relative to a clean trend-gated #4.
evidence: crowding_z = 1.8, crowded = true (highest in top ranks)
rank 2 but momentum rank-IC ~0 (no return edge from the rank itself)
durability_bar = 0.85, hurst_tag = 'trend' (cohesion is strong, which is exactly why crowd risk is elevated)
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity is a durable thematic with genuine secular demand; perfect breadth and a high durability bar suggest the trend is broad-based, not a narrow speculative top — avoiding it may forfeit continued leadership.

falsifier.text: CIBR's crowding_z falls below 1.0 while its rank stays in the top 3 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Robotics & Automation
theses.thesis: Robotics & Automation carries a 'mean-revert' hurst tag among otherwise trend-oriented mid-rank themes (rank 15, score 0.465). The absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge and this theme's trend health is the weakest kind in the eligible set — mean-revert tags historically signal chop rather than staying power. No positive lean is warranted.
evidence: hurst_tag = 'mean-revert' (only theme in ranks 1-17 with this tag besides Reshoring)
eligible = true but durability_bar = 0.56 (below the 0.65+ of healthier trends)
crowding_z = -0.06 (not crowded, but that does not create a buy case)
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tags can mark a basing phase before a new trend; if robotics themes are consolidating after a selloff, avoidance could miss an early turn. But this is unproven forward.

falsifier.text: BOTZ breaks above its 50-day high on above-average volume before the check-by date
